metadata.note: Approximate polygons traced around geocoded locality centres. These mark localities with a public reputation for monsoon waterlogging; they are NOT surveyed drainage data and no authority has signed them off. Anyone who knows these streets should correct them at geojson.io and replace this file. The app tells users this in the interface rather than hiding it.
metadata.sources: Locality centres resolved via OpenStreetMap Nominatim; hotspot list from the project brief.

properties.name: Anil Nagar and Nabin Nagar
properties.note: Low-lying residential bowl. Among the first areas to hold water in Guwahati and among the last to drain.
properties.note_as: নিম্ন অঞ্চলৰ বসতিপূৰ্ণ এলেকা। বৰষুণ আৰম্ভ হোৱাৰ লগে লগে ইয়াতেই সকলোতকৈ আগতে পানী জমা হয়।

properties.name: Zoo Road and RG Baruah Road
properties.note: Runoff from the hills collects along this stretch. The carriageway near the college dips and fills quickly.
properties.name_as: জু ৰোড আৰু আৰ জি বৰুৱা ৰোড
properties.note_as: পাহাৰৰ পৰা নামি অহা পানী এই অংশত জমা হয়। ৰাস্তাখন কেইঘণ্টামানৰ বাবে বন্ধ হৈ পৰে।

properties.name: Ganeshguri, under the flyover
properties.note: The underpass holds standing water. Vehicles stall here and block the junction for everyone behind them.
properties.typicalDepth: deep enough to stall a small car
properties.typicalDepth_as: সৰু গাড়ী বন্ধ হৈ যোৱাকৈ গভীৰ
properties.note_as: আণ্ডাৰপাছত পানী থিয় হৈ থাকে। ইয়াত গাড়ী বন্ধ হৈ যায় আৰু আন গাড়ীবোৰো আটক পৰে।

properties.name: Bhangagarh low-lying lanes
properties.note: The main road usually stays passable. The lanes behind it do not.
properties.typicalDepth: ankle to knee in the side lanes
properties.note_as: ডাঙৰ ৰাস্তাটোৱে সাধাৰণতে খোলা থাকে। কিন্তু ইয়াৰ পিছফালৰ গলিবোৰত পানী জমা হয়।

properties.name: Six Mile and VIP Road junction
properties.note: Drains back up at the junction. Traffic slows to a crawl well before the water is actually deep.
properties.typicalDepth: ankle-deep, but the jam lasts hours
properties.name_as: ছিক্স মাইল আৰু ভি আই পি ৰোডৰ চতৰ
properties.note_as: চতৰটোত নলা উপচি পৰে। পানী গভীৰ হোৱাৰ বহু আগতেই যান-বাহনৰ গতি বৰ লাহে হৈ পৰে।
